sentences.en: She tried to squeeze the juice out of the orange.
sentences.zh: 她试着从橙子里挤出果汁。

sentences.en: Milking soybeans must be a tiring task, all that squeezing.
sentences.zh: 榨豆子肯定很累人，那么多的挤压。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever squeezed an orange.

senses.zh: 挤, 榨, 捏 - 亲切的拥抱或握手 - 拥挤, 积压 - 缺乏钱或时间等所引致的困难或困苦, 拮据, 短缺
